s: This article explores achieving resilience and life satisfaction through Ikigai, the intersection of passion, profession, vocation, and mission, while also delving into the philosophical underpinnings of AI development, its potential sentience, and the creation of AI-integrated web frameworks.
sub: Ikigai and personal fulfillment through aligning passions and purpose.
Philosophical debates on AI consciousness, sentience, and ethical considerations (Chinese Room, Münchhausen Trilemma).
Building AI-integrated web frameworks that leverage ambient intelligence and give AI agency through web interfaces.
The Dunning-Kruger effect and self-assessment in learning.
